description: Expected values for the cross-screen count definitions (A3). Read by tests/Meridian.Tests/Ui/CrossScreenCountDefinitionsTests.cs (C#, CrossScreenCountDefinitions) and src/Meridian.Ui/dashboard/src/lib/cross-screen-counts.test.ts (TypeScript, lib/cross-screen-counts.ts), so the server, WPF and the browser count with one definition. Add a case here before changing either implementation.

providerHealth.name: warning, degraded and blocked rows are listed but not healthy
status matching ignores case and surrounding space

providerStatus.name: no readiness row keeps the listed status
no readiness row keeps an unrecognised listed status as sent
ready readiness and a healthy listing are healthy
ready readiness never hides a listed warning
blocked readiness outranks a healthy listing
degraded readiness outranks a listed warning
a listed block outranks degraded readiness
an unrecognised listed status beside readiness is a warning

providerEvidenceStaleness.name: healthy on evidence within three days stays healthy
healthy on evidence older than three days is a warning
no timestamped evidence is unknown, not stale
only a healthy status is capped

openBreaks.name: open and in review are open
resolved, dismissed and signed off are closed
each break counted once across a mixed queue

openOrders.name: every order the order manager reports open counts, whatever its working state
